name: Indiana

response.rule_text: A written (mail/fax) request is deemed denied if not answered within seven days of receipt; in-person or phone requests are deemed denied immediately on refusal or after 24 hours, Ind. Code § 5-14-3-9.

fees.labor_rule: Agencies generally may not charge to inspect, search for, examine or review a record to decide disclosability (court-ordered exceptions), Ind. Code § 5-14-3-8.
fees.copy_rule: Non-state agencies: up to the greater of 10 cents per B&W page (25 cents color) or actual copy cost; state agencies follow a uniform fee set by the Dept of Administration, not above the greater of average cost or 10 cents per page, § 5-14-3-8.
fees.waiver_rule: No mandatory waivers (as of 2017); agencies may waive at discretion.

residency.rule_text: 'Any person' may inspect and copy public records, Ind. Code § 5-14-3-3(a).

appeal.body: Public Access Counselor (advisory), then any court of competent jurisdiction
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; the requester may file a complaint with the Public Access Counselor within 30 days of the denial (Ind. Code § 5-14-5) who issues an advisory opinion within 30 days, and may sue in court; AG has no enforcement role.

notes: Governor/legislature/universities/school districts not extracted (Pence 'white paper' case only). The 30-day PAC complaint window per RCFP time text (Ind. Code § 5-14-5-7 not captured).
